    with np.errstate(all='ignore'):
        result = np.quantile(
            np.array([[1,2,3,4]]*2), 
            0.5, 
            weights=np.array([[1,np.inf,1,1],[0.5]*4], dtype='f8'), 
            method='inverted_cdf', 
            axis=1
        )
    probe("np.quantile(np.array([[1,2,3,4]]*2), 0.5, weights=np.array([[1,np.inf,1,1],[0.5]*4], dtype='f8'), method='inverted_cdf', axis=1) (inside np.errstate(all='ignore'))", result)
except Exception as e:
    probe_exception("np.quantile(np.array([[1,2,3,4]]*2), 0.5, weights=np.array([[1,np.inf,1,1],[0.5]*4], dtype='f8'), method='inverted_cdf', axis=1) (inside np.errstate(all='ignore'))", e)

    weights = np.array([1, np.inf, 1, 1], dtype='f8')
    result = np.quantile(
        np.array([1, 2, 3, 4]),
        0.5,
        weights=weights,
        method='inverted_cdf'
    )
    probe("test_inf_zeroes_err parametrized weights: [1, inf, 1, 1], f8", result)
